def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    # Avoid negative or zero capacity by clamping to a small positive value
    remaining_capacity = np.maximum(remaining_capacity, 1e-9)
    # Higher remaining capacity means higher priority
    return 1 / remaining_capacity

    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - np.min(bins)  # Normalize by subtracting min to prioritize higher remaining space
    # Avoid division by zero
    remaining = np.where(remaining == 0, 1e-10, remaining)
    # Prioritize bins with more remaining space (higher remaining capacity), scaled by available room
    scores = remaining / (bins + 1e-10)  # Normalize by bin capacity to avoid bias toward larger bins
    # Reverse score to make higher remaining capacity = higher priority
    return scores
